title: Union of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: Waiting for him at the end of the passage was not the legendary Eye of Heavenly Dao itself—but another, older and more terrifying existence, toying with all the players in the guise of prey.

text.content: The moment that ultimate gaze pierced through the Void, Chen Ji felt as if an invisible giant hand had lifted him bodily off the chessboard of destiny, suspending him mid-air for inspection. His Tianji Record Fragment quivered violently, the runes on both sides flowing like boiling mercury, and an unprecedented resonance exploded from within him—not pain, but a strange sense of completeness, as if the other half of his soul, lost for a millennium, had finally returned.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his voice unnaturally cold) ...Chen Jie.

text.content: In the depths of the chaotic Void, another figure gradually formed. With a face identical to Chen Ji's, yet possessing a diametrically opposed aura—sinister, fierce, with unquenchable wild fire burning in his eyes. The darkness beneath his feet seemed alive, writhing and corroding all light that dared approach. This was Heaven's Calamity Qi, originating from the same source as Chen Ji's Heavenly Secrets power, now resonating like yin and yang poles across an infinite distance.

dialogue.content: (That ultimate gaze transformed into a low, resonant laughter that shook the entire Void) Interesting... The twin sons of destiny have finally met upon my chessboard. The Tianji Record and the Tianjie Record, the positive and the reverse, indispensable to each other.

text.content: Chen Ji's mind felt like it was exploding—Tianjie Record! A name he had never heard before, yet now thundered in his ears. So he was not the sole chosen one. That lost fragment had never truly vanished, merely fallen into the hands of another connected by blood. The irony of fate could be no sharper. He gazed at that face mirroring his own like a reflection, an inexplicable bitterness rising in his throat.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) Twin sons of destiny? Hmph, you want us brothers to tear each other apart so you can reap the benefits?

text.content: Just then, a sudden异变 erupted. Both fragments simultaneously blazed with blinding radiance, the runes on their opposing sides beginning to interweave and entwine, spiraling upward like two yin-yang fish. In the depths of the Void, a deep, dark rift slowly tore open—and at its end, a massive eye could be faintly seen, overlooking all with a perspective beyond comprehension. That was the true core of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the forbidden realm that supposedly held dominion over the fate of all worlds.

dialogue.content: (That voice grew increasingly ethereal) The rift is open, the entrance revealed. However, this gate requires both of you to open it together. Cooperate, or be trapped in eternity together—the choice is in your hands.

text.content: Chen Jie was the first to speak, his voice like shattered ice striking jade: "Cooperate? I'd rather hear what qualifications you have, my brother who's never seen the light, to stand beside me." He raised his hand, and Heaven's Calamity Qi transformed into thousands of blades hovering at his side. "Every step I've taken has been through mountains of corpses and seas of blood. And you? A waste hiding in a sect corner, barely surviving—凭什么？"

choice.prompt: Faced with Chen Jie's provocation and questioning, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Overwhelm the other's blind arrogance with information superiority, demonstrate the true style of a mastermind, making Chen Jie understand who the real chess player is.
choices.risk_hint: Premature exposure might cause the Eye of Heavenly Dao to adjust its strategy

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, containing no anger, only the composure of one who has seen through everything. He stepped forward leisurely, each step landing precisely on the nodes of Chen Jie's densest killing intent, yet appearing as if strolling in a garden. "Mountains of corpses and seas of blood?" he repeated softly. "During three years at the Holy Sect, you killed seventeen competitors, yet overlooked the shadow beneath your feet—those seventeen people's underlying forces have already been quietly relocated by me."

dialogue.content: (Nonchalantly) You think you're the hunter, but the timing, targets, and consequences of every strike you've made—all have been within my calculations. A waste? Hmph, that was merely the protective coloration that kept you alive until today.

choices.description: No longer conceal, directly demonstrate the true strength beneath the useless exterior using the power of the Tianji Record, proving oneself through overwhelming dominance.
choices.risk_hint: Possibly Triggering the Eye of Heavenly Dao to Close the Net Early

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely lifting his right hand. The Tianji Record Fragment abruptly unfurled, golden runes pouring forth like a flood, completely engulfing Chen Jie's thousands of murderous blades. In the next instant, those blades turned, all pointing at their master!

dialogue.content: (Eyes ice-cold) I told you, the Tianji Record allows me to foresee three hours into the future. Every trajectory of your attacks appears to me as frozen frames. I decide who it points to.

choices.description: Refuse to be kidnapped by fate, retreat to advance, make the Heavenly Eye understand it needs this pair of twins, not that Chen Ji needs it.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the chance to enter the core
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative, make the other party come seeking cooperation
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may forcibly detain

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, his back to the rift and Chen Jie, his voice cold as frost: "You say you need us to open it together? Then wait until you've figured out how much you need us, before we talk again." His figure began to dissolve, as if about to merge into the void, "I have all the time in the world—and you?"

dialogue.content: (That ultimate gaze fluctuated for the first time) You think you have the right to refuse?

text.content: Just then, an eerie tremor came from the depths of the rift. That enormous eye slowly turned, and deep within the pupil, countless figures could be vaguely seen struggling and wailing—they were the seers of past generations who had failed in their attempts to enter the core, their residual souls forever imprisoned within, becoming nourishment for the Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji's heart chilled—this was the true face of the Heavenly Eye: it wasn't invincible, it was simply that all challengers became its food.

dialogue.content: (In a low voice) So this rift is nothing more than a gaping maw?

text.content: Chen Jie's expression changed too. Though arrogant, he wasn't foolish. The tense atmosphere from moments ago strangely eased. The two exchanged a glance, seeing the same thing in each other's eyes for the first time—wariness toward a being beyond comprehension. Fraternal strife could be settled another day, but if a third party treats them as chess pieces to be devoured, there would be nothing left.

dialogue.content: (Looking at Chen Jie) Seems you understand too. This door isn't a path to freedom—it's a path to its appetite.

choice.prompt: Facing this entrance that may be a trap, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: Temporarily cooperate with Chen Jie to probe the true nature of the rift at minimal cost, gathering intelligence for subsequent decisions.
choices.risk_hint: May be devoured by the rift

text.content: Chen Ji raised the Tianji Record, and a golden rune drifted slowly toward the rift's entrance. The moment the rune touched the edge of the rift, an ear-piercing shriek resounded through the void, and the imprisoned residual souls wildly flung themselves at the rune, only to turn to ash upon contact. Deep within the rift, that eye's pupil suddenly constricted—was it in anger, or in... fear?

dialogue.content: (Eyes brightening) It fears my power of heavenly secrets. Or rather—it fears the complete form of the Tianji Record.

choices.text: Use their own methods against them
choices.description: Utilize the resonance between heavenly tribulation energy and the power of heavenly secrets, attempt to reversely devour the Heavenly Eye's power, walk a path no one has walked before.

text.content: Chen Ji made a mad move. He pressed the Tianji Record Fragment directly against the rift. Golden and black energies collided violently the moment they touched. Instead of the anticipated destruction, the rift let out a pained howl like a beast whose scales had been touched, and vast energy surged into Chen Ji's body like a tide—the residual power of generations of seers, the essence that the Heavenly Eye had devoured for a thousand years!

dialogue.content: (Agonizing pain yet wild laughter) Good...good one, Heavenly Eye! So all your power was stolen from them! Today, I will make you spit it all out with interest!

choices.text: Negotiating with the tiger for its skin
choices.description: Direct dialogue with the Heavenly Eye, exchanging benefits to obtain the true conditions for entering the core, without wasting energy.

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew all offensive strategies, standing with hands clasped behind his back, his voice eerily calm: "What do you want? Don't give me that 'fate's arrangement' nonsense—we're both chess players. Let's discuss something practical." The eyes fell silent for a moment. The void's gaze seemed to temper its ferocity, seemingly reassessing this insignificant creature before it.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) You're finally showing some intelligence. The terms are straightforward—enter the core and retrieve something for me. In return, I can tell you where your sister Chen Nian is.

text.content: The name "Chen Nian" struck like a thunderbolt in Chen Ji's mind. His pupils constricted sharply. In that instant, the cold facade he had meticulously constructed over years nearly fractured. His sister—the girl taken by the Holy Sect, becoming the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"—had been his deepest obsession beyond completing the Tianji Record. Yet now, this very desire was being wielded as a bargaining chip by the Heavenly Eye. What did this signify? Did it mean Chen Nian was hidden within the Heavenly Eye's core? Or was this an elaborate trap designed to exploit his weakness? Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain composed. Regardless, this was a trial he must confront.

dialogue.content: (Voice dropping) You know where my sister is?

text.content: Chen Jie watched coldly from the side, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. "So even the brother has weaknesses." His voice carried a hint of schadenfreude, yet also a thread of curiosity. "Heavenly Fate Lock Key... interesting. The Holy Sect truly has ulterior motives." In the void, that ultimate gaze transformed into a low laughter, thundering like a drum: "Chen Nian is the final key to unlock the core. You two together are merely secondary conditions—she is the true crux. Without her, you will forever wander outside the door."

choice.prompt: Facing this shocking truth about his sister, how should Chen Ji make his choice?

choices.description: No matter if there are traps or abyss ahead, as long as he can save Chen Nian, Chen Ji is willing to pay any price—including making a deal with the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the possibility to rescue his sister
choices.risk_hint: The sister may have been completely transformed

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes became incomparably resolute at this moment—that was the brotherly love hidden beneath thetrash外表 for over a decade. He stepped forward, his voice low yet unyielding: "I accept your conditions. Tell me how to enter, how to find her."

dialogue.content: (Staring directly at that eye) But I warn you—if my sister suffers even a scratch, I will make the complete form of the Tianji Record your eternal nightmare for generations to come.

choices.description: The more things relate to his sister, the more he must stay calm, questioning the Heavenly Eye's true intentions, seeking flaws and conspiracies within.
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may change its strategy

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the turmoil in his heart and sneered: "What a convenient bargaining chip. How do you know I was looking for her? And how do you know she is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'?" He stepped back, creating distance from the fissure, "Regarding Chen Nian's affairs, no more than three people know. Where did you obtain your intelligence?"

dialogue.content: (Narrowing his eyes) Or perhaps—from beginning to end, including the Holy Sect taking her away—this was all part of your scheme?

choices.description: Since Chen Nian is the key, cooperating with Chen Jie becomes even more necessary—only when the two fragments resonate can we safely enter the core.
choices.visible_reward: Increasing the chances of entering the core
choices.risk_hint: Chen Jie may have ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji turned to Chen Jie, his gaze carrying scrutiny: "We're both fragment holders. None of us can enter alone." He extended his hand, golden light in his palm confronting the other's black aura, "You're interested in Chen Nian's affairs too, aren't you? After all—" he paused meaningfully, "the master of the Tianji Record shouldn't be content to be someone else's pawn forever."

dialogue.content: (Cold smile) Both of us know clearly that the Eye of Heavenly Secrets never intended to let us leave alive. It just needs a tool—and we can choose not to be that tool.

text.content:
As the three parties reached a stalemate, a crisp cracking sound suddenly echoed from the depths of the fissure. Within that giant eye, a tiny crack had appeared—the accumulated resentment of generations of prophets, and the most unwelcome weakness of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

At the same time, a familiar aura permeated from the fissure, faint yet distinct. Chen Ji's body froze abruptly—that was... Chen Nian's aura! Though blurred nearly beyond recognition, the blood connection's感应 was unmistakable—his younger sister was truly inside!

In that instant, all calculations, considerations, and schemes became secondary. For the first time, a crack called "agitation" appeared on that perpetually calm face of thetrash Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring softly) Xiao Nian... wait for me.

text.content:
Chen Jie gazed at his brother's briefly unguarded expression, and a complex light flickered in his eyes. He recalled his days in the lightless depths of the Holy Sect, those endless nights when he was treated as a chess piece. So even this seemingly cold-blooded, calculating brother had such a vulnerable side.

"Interesting." Chen Jie murmured quietly, "It seems both of us, twin fates bound together, have a sister who was taken away—only mine is already dead in their hands." His tone was terrifyingly calm, "So, brother—I changed my mind. I'll wade through these murky waters with you. Not to help you, but to seek justice for myself—and for all the chess pieces crushed by this broken game board."

In the Void, that ultimate gaze seemed to sense the shift in the two brothers' attitudes. After a moment of silence, it let out a meaningful sigh. The fissure slowly expanded, and a bridge woven from golden and black dual-colored light extended from the entrance, hovering silently before Chen Ji and Chen Jie.

"Since you've made your choice—" the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice rang out again, but with less of the previous high-and-mighty arrogance, "then go. What awaits you at the end of this passage may be truth, may be death, or perhaps... something more terrifying than death."

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, gazing at the bridge leading into the unknown. He knew once he stepped onto this path, there would be no turning back. But he knew even more deeply—if he couldn't even take this step, what right did he have to call himself a qualified chess player?

Moreover, in the deepest part of that fissure, he seemed to see a blurred figure, watching him quietly across the endless Void. That silhouette... was Chen Nian.

"Let's go." Chen Ji's voice was calm yet firm, as he became the first to step onto the bridge of destiny.
